header.running_head: Seeking Honour Where Allaah has Placed Honour

blocks.text:

His saddle blanket when he rode was a woollen blanket made in Ambijaan, which doubled as a bedding when he camped. His satchel was striped cloth filled with the bark of a date palm, which doubled as his pillow when he was not riding. He wore a thick white cotton Qamees which was patched and torn on the side.
"Send the leader of these people to me," Hadhrat Umar (RA) commanded.
When the people sent for the head priest, Hadhrat Umar (RA) said to him, "Please wash my Qamees, mend it and borrow me a Qamees or some clothing. A Qamees made from Kattaan (a very fine and expensive cloth) was then brought to Hadhrat Umar (RA). "What is this?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) enquired. When the people told him that it was Kattaan, he asked, "And what is Kattaan?" After they explained to him what it was, he removed his Qamees and it was washed and patched. When it was returned to him, he took off the Kattaan one and wore his own.
The head priest then said to him, "Because you are the king of the Arabs, it is not befitting that you ride a camel in these parts. If you ride a Turkish horse and wear some other clothing, it would command more respect in the eyes of the Romans. Hadhrat Umar (RA) however said, "We are people who have been given respect because of Islaam and therefore do not wish any substitute."
A Turkish horse was then brought and rather than a saddle or carriage, a mere saddle blanket was thrown over it. Hadhrat Umar (RA) rode it but (when it started to strut) he called out, "Stop it! Stop it! I have never seen people riding a Shaytaan before this (because riding it brings pride in the rider)." Hadhrat Umar (RA)'s camel was then brought and he rode it.[^1]
Giving Consideration to the Dhimmi Community when in a position of Honour

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abu Nuhayk and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Handhala
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abu Nuhayk and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Handhala report, "We were with Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) in an army when someone recited Surah Maryam. Another man (probably a Jew) then started to vilify Hadhrat Maryam (RA) and her son (Hadhrat Isa (AS)). We then assaulted the man and hit him until he was bleeding. Since every person who was wronged in any way complained to Hadhrat Salmaan (RA), this man also complained to him even though he had never done so before. Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) therefore approached us and asked why we had assaulted the man. 'We were reciting Surah Maryam,' we explained, 'when he started to vilify Hadhrat Maryam (RA) and her son (Hadhrat Isa (AS)).' Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) rebuked us saying, 'Then why did you make him listen to it? Did you not hear what Allaah says? (Allaah says:)

blocks.arabic_text: وَلَا تَسُبُّوا الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ فَيَسُبُّوا اللَّهَ عَدْوًا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ

blocks.text: Ibn Abi Dunya, as quoted in Al Bidaayah wan Nihaayah (Vol.7 Pg.60).
